criterionContrastAudit.comparison: Task Achievement is strong: all bullets are fully covered with relevant, detailed content. Grammatical Range and Accuracy is the weakest because while accurate, the range is narrow with repeated simple and compound structures, and limited complex use.
criterionContrastAudit.uniformProfileJustification: Bands are not uniform due to differences across criteria.

criterionContrastAudit.comparison: Grammar is consistently controlled with only minor slips, whereas coherence relies on a conventional letter structure with some mechanical paragraph transitions and lack of subtle cohesion.

Task Achievement is the strongest criterion because the letter fully addresses all bullets with precise, well-developed detail, sustained appropriate tone, and a clear purpose. Grammatical Range and Accuracy is marginally weaker due to a few minor errors, but still demonstrates wide range and control. Coherence and Cohesion and Lexical Resource are very strong, with only extremely rare lapses.

scoreCalculation.formula: The final AI-selected four criterion bands are averaged equally and rounded to the nearest half band. General examiner and specialist results are never averaged together.
